definitions.full: H4766. marbeh מַרְבֶּה noun [masculine] 1 abundance ; — absolute ׳מ Isa 33:23 , as adverb, in abundance. 2 increase (?), construct לְםַרְבֵּה (sic) Isa 9:6 for the increase of the dominion (take לם as dittograph of foregoing, and read ᵐ5 רַבָּה, Gr Che Kit Buhl Lex Marti; Du לְמַרְבֵךְ , in view of following לְשָׂלוֺם ).
